meta.description: Configurable multilingual portfolio template built with Flask.

paragraphs: Use this section to introduce yourself, your interests, and the kind of work you want to do.
Add a few details that help visitors understand your approach. Keep every statement accurate and specific to you.

sections.body: Describe the user need, the problem to solve, and any important constraints.

sections.title: Approach
items: Summarize the research or discovery that informed the work.
Describe the solution and the decisions behind it.
List tools or technologies only when they are relevant to the project.

items: Explain the work you personally completed.
Clarify how you collaborated with others.

items: Add measured results only when you can verify them.
